[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.14.0 - Montaillou[/b][/size]

Montaillou is a Cathar village with an Inquisitor sitting in it, taking depositions about what
people eat on a Friday. It is the densest writing left in Lionheart, and it shipped with the
largest block of finished, unreachable dialogue the project has found: 49 nodes carrying player
replies that nothing in the game could open.

The Templar knights at the gate stop you and ask your business, in a scene that knows whether you
are an Inquisitor, a Templar, a Knight of Saladin or nobody -- it was never wired because three of
its answers pointed at nodes that do not exist. The titans camped in the ruins of Toulouse can be
talked into letting their fugitive speak for himself, and the fugitive can be persuaded or tricked
into going back to them; the four nodes that finish that route shipped flagged "[REMOVED FROM
GAME]" while Lethos went on advertising it out loud. Na Roqua answers a sworn Inquisitor, remembers
the chicken, and offers her hidden stash to a friend of the Cathars.

And then the village learns to read you. The mugger in the square recognises one of Juanita's
thieves. The gate knights have something to say to a man wearing the Goblin Khan's honours. The
Bishop, reciting his ninety-eight cases of heresy, can be told by a necromancer that he has missed
one.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. The gate and the witch need a character who has not
entered Montaillou. Unplayed -- what you find goes into 0.14.1.
